versos.grego: Αὐτοὶ γὰρ οἴδατε, ἀδελφοί, τὴν εἴσοδον ἡμῶν τὴν πρὸς ὑμᾶς, ὅτι οὐ κενὴ γέγονεν,

controles.web: For you yourselves know, brothers, our visit to you wasn’t in vain,
controles.kjv: For yourselves, brethren, know our entrance in unto you, that it was not in vain:
controles.livre: Pois vós mesmos, irmãos, sabeis que a nossa passagem por entre vós não foi inútil.

versos.grego: ἀλλὰ προπαθόντες καὶ ὑβρισθέντες καθὼς οἴδατε ἐν Φιλίπποις ἐπαρρησιασάμεθα ἐν τῷ Θεῷ ἡμῶν λαλῆσαι πρὸς ὑμᾶς τὸ εὐαγγέλιον τοῦ Θεοῦ ἐν πολλῷ ἀγῶνι.

controles.web: but having suffered before and been shamefully treated, as you know, at Philippi, we grew bold in our God to tell you the Good News of God in much conflict.
controles.kjv: But even after that we had suffered before, and were shamefully entreated, as ye know, at Philippi, we were bold in our God to speak unto you the gospel of God with much contention.
controles.livre: Porém, mesmo que antes, em Filipos, tenhamos sofrido e sido maltratados, como sabeis, tivemos no nosso Deus ousadia para vos falar o evangelho de Deus em meio a muita oposição.

versos.grego: ἡ γὰρ παράκλησις ἡμῶν οὐκ ἐκ πλάνης οὐδὲ ἐξ ἀκαθαρσίας οὐδὲ ἐν δόλῳ,

controles.web: For our exhortation is not of error, nor of uncleanness, nor in deception.
controles.kjv: For our exhortation was not of deceit, nor of uncleanness, nor in guile:
controles.livre: Pois a nossa exortação não foi com engano, nem com impureza, nem fraude;

versos.grego: ἀλλὰ καθὼς δεδοκιμάσμεθα ὑπὸ τοῦ Θεοῦ πιστευθῆναι τὸ εὐαγγέλιον οὕτως λαλοῦμεν, οὐχ ὡς ἀνθρώποις ἀρέσκοντες, ἀλλὰ Θεῷ τῷ δοκιμάζοντι τὰς καρδίας ἡμῶν.

controles.web: But even as we have been approved by God to be entrusted with the Good News, so we speak; not as pleasing men, but God, who tests our hearts.
controles.kjv: But as we were allowed of God to be put in trust with the gospel, even so we speak; not as pleasing men, but God, which trieth our hearts.
controles.livre: mas, como fomos aprovados por Deus para que o evangelho nos fosse confiado, assim falamos; não para agradar as pessoas, mas sim a Deus, que prova os nossos corações.

versos.grego: οὔτε γάρ ποτε ἐν λόγῳ κολακίας ἐγενήθημεν, καθὼς οἴδατε, οὔτε ἐν προφάσει πλεονεξίας, Θεὸς μάρτυς,

controles.web: For neither were we at any time found using words of flattery, as you know, nor a cloak of covetousness (God is witness),
controles.kjv: For neither at any time used we flattering words, as ye know, nor a cloke of covetousness; God is witness:
controles.livre: Pois, como sabeis, nunca usamos palavras de lisonja, nem pretexto de ganância; Deus é testemunha.

versos.grego: οὔτε ζητοῦντες ἐξ ἀνθρώπων δόξαν, οὔτε ἀφ’ ὑμῶν οὔτε ἀπ’ ἄλλων,

controles.web: nor seeking glory from men (neither from you nor from others), when we might have claimed authority as apostles of Christ.
controles.kjv: Nor of men sought we glory, neither of you, nor yet of others, when we might have been burdensome, as the apostles of Christ.
controles.livre: Não buscamos a glória humana, nem de vós, nem de outros, ainda que tínhamos autoridade, como apóstolos de Cristo, para demandar de vós.

versos.grego: δυνάμενοι ἐν βάρει εἶναι ὡς Χριστοῦ ἀπόστολοι· ἀλλὰ ἐγενήθημεν ἤπιοι ἐν μέσῳ ὑμῶν, ὡς ἐὰν τροφὸς θάλπῃ τὰ ἑαυτῆς τέκνα·

controles.web: But we were gentle among you, like a nursing mother cherishes her own children.
controles.kjv: But we were gentle among you, even as a nurse cherisheth her children:
controles.livre: Porém fomos suaves entre vós, como uma mãe que dá carinho aos seus filhos.

versos.grego: οὕτως ὁμειρόμενοι ὑμῶν εὐδοκοῦμεν μεταδοῦναι ὑμῖν οὐ μόνον τὸ εὐαγγέλιον τοῦ Θεοῦ ἀλλὰ καὶ τὰς ἑαυτῶν ψυχάς, διότι ἀγαπητοὶ ἡμῖν ἐγενήθητε.

controles.web: Even so, affectionately longing for you, we were well pleased to impart to you, not the Good News of God only, but also our own souls, because you had become very dear to us.
controles.kjv: So being affectionately desirous of you, we were willing to have imparted unto you, not the gospel of God only, but also our own souls, because ye were dear unto us.
controles.livre: Assim nós, tendo tanta afeição por vós, queríamos de boa vontade compartilhar convosco não somente o evangelho de Deus, mas também as nossas próprias almas, porque éreis queridos por nós.

versos.grego: μνημονεύετε γάρ, ἀδελφοί, τὸν κόπον ἡμῶν καὶ τὸν μόχθον· νυκτὸς καὶ ἡμέρας ἐργαζόμενοι πρὸς τὸ μὴ ἐπιβαρῆσαί τινα ὑμῶν ἐκηρύξαμεν εἰς ὑμᾶς τὸ εὐαγγέλιον τοῦ Θεοῦ.

controles.web: For you remember, brothers, our labor and travail; for working night and day, that we might not burden any of you, we preached to you the Good News of God.
controles.kjv: For ye remember, brethren, our labour and travail: for labouring night and day, because we would not be chargeable unto any of you, we preached unto you the gospel of God.
controles.livre: Pois vos lembrais, irmãos, do nosso trabalho e fadiga; enquanto vos pregávamos o evangelho de Deus, trabalhávamos noite e dia para que não fôssemos um peso para vós.

versos.grego: ὑμεῖς μάρτυρες καὶ ὁ Θεός, ὡς ὁσίως καὶ δικαίως καὶ ἀμέμπτως ὑμῖν τοῖς πιστεύουσιν ἐγενήθημεν,

controles.web: You are witnesses with God, how holy, righteously, and blamelessly we behaved ourselves toward you who believe.
controles.kjv: Ye are witnesses, and God also, how holily and justly and unblameably we behaved ourselves among you that believe:
controles.livre: Vós e Deus sois testemunhas de como foi santa, justa, e irrepreensível a maneira da qual nos comportamos convosco, que credes.

versos.grego: καθάπερ οἴδατε ὡς ἕνα ἕκαστον ὑμῶν ὡς πατὴρ τέκνα ἑαυτοῦ

controles.web: As you know, we exhorted, comforted, and implored every one of you, as a father does his own children,
controles.kjv: As ye know how we exhorted and comforted and charged every one of you, as a father doth his children,
controles.livre: Assim como sabeis que, como um pai aos seus filhos, exortávamos, consolávamos, e testemunhávamos a cada um de vós,

versos.grego: παρακαλοῦντες ὑμᾶς καὶ παραμυθούμενοι καὶ μαρτυρόμενοι εἰς τὸ περιπατεῖν ὑμᾶς ἀξίως τοῦ Θεοῦ τοῦ καλοῦντος ὑμᾶς εἰς τὴν ἑαυτοῦ βασιλείαν καὶ δόξαν.

controles.web: to the end that you should walk worthily of God, who calls you into his own Kingdom and glory.
controles.kjv: That ye would walk worthy of God, who hath called you unto his kingdom and glory.
controles.livre: para que andásseis de maneira digna diante de Deus, que vos chama para o seu reino e glória.

versos.grego: Καὶ διὰ τοῦτο καὶ ἡμεῖς εὐχαριστοῦμεν τῷ Θεῷ ἀδιαλείπτως, ὅτι παραλαβόντες λόγον ἀκοῆς παρ’ ἡμῶν τοῦ Θεοῦ ἐδέξασθε οὐ λόγον ἀνθρώπων ἀλλὰ καθὼς ἀληθῶς ἐστὶν λόγον Θεοῦ, ὃς καὶ ἐνεργεῖται ἐν ὑμῖν τοῖς πιστεύουσιν.

controles.web: For this cause we also thank God without ceasing, that, when you received from us the word of the message of God, you accepted it not as the word of men, but, as it is in truth, the word of God, which also works in you who believe.
controles.kjv: For this cause also thank we God without ceasing, because, when ye received the word of God which ye heard of us, ye received it not as the word of men, but as it is in truth, the word of God, which effectually worketh also in you that believe.
controles.livre: Por isso também agradecemos sem cessar a Deus, que, quando recebestes a palavra da Deus pregada por nós, a recebestes, não como palavra de homens, mas (conforme em verdade é) como a palavra de Deus, a qual também opera em vós, que credes.

versos.grego: ὑμεῖς γὰρ μιμηταὶ ἐγενήθητε, ἀδελφοί, τῶν ἐκκλησιῶν τοῦ Θεοῦ τῶν οὐσῶν ἐν τῇ Ἰουδαίᾳ ἐν Χριστῷ Ἰησοῦ, ὅτι τὰ αὐτὰ ἐπάθετε καὶ ὑμεῖς ὑπὸ τῶν ἰδίων συμφυλετῶν, καθὼς καὶ αὐτοὶ ὑπὸ τῶν Ἰουδαίων,

controles.web: For you, brothers, became imitators of the assemblies of God which are in Judea in Christ Jesus; for you also suffered the same things from your own countrymen, even as they did from the Jews;
controles.kjv: For ye, brethren, became followers of the churches of God which in Judea are in Christ Jesus: for ye also have suffered like things of your own countrymen, even as they have of the Jews:
controles.livre: Pois vós, irmãos, vos tornastes imitadores das igrejas de Deus que estão na Judeia em Cristo Jesus; porque também sofrestes as mesmas coisas dos vossos próprios compatriotas, como também eles dos judeus;

versos.grego: τῶν καὶ τὸν Κύριον ἀποκτεινάντων Ἰησοῦν καὶ τοὺς προφήτας καὶ ἡμᾶς ἐκδιωξάντων, καὶ Θεῷ μὴ ἀρεσκόντων, καὶ πᾶσιν ἀνθρώποις ἐναντίων,

controles.web: who killed both the Lord Jesus and their own prophets, and drove us out, and didn’t please God, and are contrary to all men;
controles.kjv: Who both killed the Lord Jesus, and their own prophets, and have persecuted us; and they please not God, and are contrary to all men:
controles.livre: que também mataram o Senhor Jesus e os profetas, e nos perseguiram, e não agradam a Deus, e são contrários a todos:

versos.grego: κωλυόντων ἡμᾶς τοῖς ἔθνεσιν λαλῆσαι ἵνα σωθῶσιν, εἰς τὸ ἀναπληρῶσαι αὐτῶν τὰς ἁμαρτίας πάντοτε. ἔφθασεν δὲ ἐπ’ αὐτοὺς ἡ ὀργὴ εἰς τέλος.

controles.web: forbidding us to speak to the Gentiles that they may be saved; to fill up their sins always. But wrath has come on them to the uttermost.
controles.kjv: Forbidding us to speak to the Gentiles that they might be saved, to fill up their sins alway: for the wrath is come upon them to the uttermost.
controles.livre: eles nos impedem de falar aos gentios, para que sejam salvos. Assim eles estão se enchendo constantemente de pecados, mas, por fim, ira veio sobre eles até o fim.

versos.grego: Ἡμεῖς δέ, ἀδελφοί, ἀπορφανισθέντες ἀφ’ ὑμῶν πρὸς καιρὸν ὥρας προσώπῳ οὐ καρδίᾳ, περισσοτέρως ἐσπουδάσαμεν τὸ πρόσωπον ὑμῶν ἰδεῖν ἐν πολλῇ ἐπιθυμίᾳ.

controles.web: But we, brothers, being bereaved of you for a short season, in presence, not in heart, tried even harder to see your face with great desire,
controles.kjv: But we, brethren, being taken from you for a short time in presence, not in heart, endeavoured the more abundantly to see your face with great desire.
controles.livre: Porém, irmãos, quando nos separamos de vós por algum tempo, em presença, não no coração, buscamos mais, com muito desejo, ver o vosso rosto;

versos.grego: διότι ἠθελήσαμεν ἐλθεῖν πρὸς ὑμᾶς, ἐγὼ μὲν Παῦλος καὶ ἅπαξ καὶ δίς, καὶ ἐνέκοψεν ἡμᾶς ὁ Σατανᾶς.

controles.web: because we wanted to come to you—indeed, I, Paul, once and again—but Satan hindered us.
controles.kjv: Wherefore we would have come unto you, even I Paul, once and again; but Satan hindered us.
controles.livre: pois quisemos, pelo menos eu, Paulo, vos visitar uma vez e outra; mas Satanás nos impediu.

versos.grego: τίς γὰρ ἡμῶν ἐλπὶς ἢ χαρὰ ἢ στέφανος καυχήσεως— ἢ οὐχὶ καὶ ὑμεῖς— ἔμπροσθεν τοῦ Κυρίου ἡμῶν Ἰησοῦ ἐν τῇ αὐτοῦ παρουσίᾳ;

controles.web: For what is our hope, or joy, or crown of rejoicing? Isn’t it even you, before our Lord Jesus at his coming?
controles.kjv: For what is our hope, or joy, or crown of rejoicing? Are not even ye in the presence of our Lord Jesus Christ at his coming?
controles.livre: Pois, qual é nossa esperança, alegria, ou coroa de orgulho, diante do nosso Senhor Jesus na sua vinda? Acaso não sois vós?

versos.grego: ὑμεῖς γάρ ἐστε ἡ δόξα ἡμῶν καὶ ἡ χαρά.

controles.web: For you are our glory and our joy.
controles.kjv: For ye are our glory and joy.
controles.livre: Porque vós sois o nosso orgulho e alegria.
